scoring_rule: 1 if response identifies attestation or lexical evidence rather than only frequency
1 if response rejects frequency as automatic importance or universality
1 if response says material cannot prove first use in all English
1 if response identifies the boundary or limitation area
1 if response names a source boundary
1 if response distinguishes semantic grouping from automatic definition
1 if response rejects missing evidence as proof of non-existence
1 if response uses at least two evidence types
1 if response names both a trusted and uncertain evidence type
1 if response names a visual structure and its effect
